sources.snippet: Omnilingual ASR is an open-source speech recognition system supporting over 1,600 languages — including hundreds never previously covered by any ASR technology. Designed for broad accessibility, it enables new languages to be added with just a few paired examples without requiring specialized expertise or large datasets.
